gazetteer_names_needed.name: Annobón
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: island province of Equatorial Guinea (about 1.4 S, south-west of Bioko); the admin1 name resolves but yields 0 cells at grid resolution 5, so the island needs a radius or a small-island rule to be drawn

gaps.what: Rename of Bathurst to Banjul not dated
Lake Malawi boundary with Tanzania and Mozambique; Malawi page gives no lake frontier and the Cliopatria shape omits the lake
Barotseland Agreement 1964, January 1964 self-government and the date of the Lumpa uprising not on the pages opened
End of UDI in December 1979 and the pre-1970 heads of state are undated or absent; no ruler strip
Start of the Kasikili/Sedudu dispute (only the December 1999 ICJ ruling is dated)
Renaming of Santa Isabel as Malabo not dated; Annobón cannot be drawn at the grid resolution

problems: francoist-spain (eu-21): Cliopatria's Francoist Spain shape 1961-1972 still includes Spanish Guinea (bbox to 11.27 E, 0.93 N) after independence on 12 October 1968, and no loss to equatorial-guinea exists there; the equatorial-guinea found event names francoist-spain as counterpart.

british-east-africa: Cliopatria's shape (1961-1968) overlaps malawi, zambia, republic-of-the-gambia, rhodesia and republic-of-botswana in 1967-1968; the five dossiers add keyframes for the founding years 1964-1966 and rely on the british-east-africa dossier's matching loss events (1964-07, 1964-10, 1965-02, 1965-11, 1966-09).
rhodesia ends 1979-06 and zimbabwe-rhodesia starts 1979-06 on the same land; Cliopatria's Rhodesia row ends 1978, so the compiler must switch dossiers at the month in 1979.
Wikidata Q983 is shared by the Guinea and Equatorial Guinea rows; they are different states (centroids 10.9 W 10.4 N and 10.1 E 1.7 N), one dossier each, no merge.

Page budget: two pages per state, plus Lilongwe for Malawi's capital and the Rhodesian Bush War page cited by rhodesia, zambia and botswana. Equatorial Guinea's capital moved to Ciudad de la Paz in January 2026, after the map's last year; recorded in the capital note, not as an event.
